OpenFOAM is the main CFD code used in the group. These pages cover practical use (case setup,
solver settings, post-processing, running in parallel) and explain what the code is actually doing,
with references to the source code where that matters.

There are two actively developed versions of OpenFOAM with a shared history:
[openfoam.org](https://openfoam.org) (the OpenFOAM Foundation, developed at
[OpenFOAM/OpenFOAM-dev](https://github.com/OpenFOAM/OpenFOAM-dev)) and
[openfoam.com](https://www.openfoam.com) (ESI-OpenCFD, developed at
[openfoam/core/openfoam](https://gitlab.com/openfoam/core/openfoam)). Keyword names, utilities and
solver output can differ between them, so pages should say which version they apply to.
